Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the claim's declared definition in claims.yaml -- the two documents compared, the extractor read from each, and the relation and its direction. It changes when any of those change and not when the wording of the question does; the check function is a loop over the claims and is not part of it. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Identity moved, the comparison did not. 8ec5b45 added subset_of_pair to Pair.fingerprint; Pair.__init__ has read that key to order the operands since 1783070 (2026-09-05 20:18). Hashing today's claim with the pre-8ec5b45 formula reproduces the pinned sha256:ba019a19f7a7c39de5c5c19601580248 byte for byte, so nothing else in the claim moved. run-20260910T045212Z-de93be7 (level V, full selector) passes under the declared direction llms_txt subset-of live_species, both sides naming the same 11 symbols. The pin this replaces was set 2026-09-05 16:35, before the direction fix, so this is the first pin whose identity contains the direction.

RUN: run-20260910T045212Z-de93be7, preregistration PRE-0075, on a clean working tree at commit de93be7a3cd99a2154af870569cfe4a904c088e8. The selector was frozen and git-tagged BEFORE the run, so the set of checks could not be narrowed after seeing the results.
